scripts.verify:example: cd examples/cleaning-platform && bun ../../packages/cli/src/main.ts diff --check && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && .venv/bin/mypy src tests
scripts.verify:example:ts: cd examples/cleaning-platform-ts && bun ../../packages/cli/src/main.ts diff --check && bun install && bun run typecheck && bun run test
